label: copy-phase input m (rare, mostly early copy positions in long sequences)
explanation: Every activation (100% of mass on dev) is at a copy-phase step whose input is the fed-back token m. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on any other input token. It is very sparse even within that context, though: only about 0.55% of copy-phase m inputs activate it, so the predicate has full recall and very low precision. Within the context it is concentrated in L=9 sequences (86% of mass), at recall_idx 3-4 (that is, m was original token 2 or 3, around t=12-13), and when the token being output is s or m (about 64% of mass). Top activations look like ...m s... or ...m m... early in the copy. Combining these conditions only reaches F1 of about 0.35, so whatever selects the active m steps is not captured.
